page.layout: One page of text in a single column; running head at top with page number left; faint show-through of the facing page at the right edge and in the right margin (not transcribed); no notes printed in the margins.

main_text.p: cùs, quod ipsis eorum formis attribues, sive extrinsecùs, quod formæ corporis vicini imputabis; si nulla sit ad manum, cui negotium hoc committi posse videatur, ad asylum commune, ad Influentias cælestes confugies. Causâ primâ opus tibi est in formandis & producendis Formis substantialibus, exceptis tamen formis Elementorum, quibus speciatim concessum est sobolescere, & stirpem suam in vicinia propagare; Cæteræ formæ cælibes sunt & viduæ: & introductis in Materia Dispositionibus, ut plurimùm, à cælorum occultis [virtutibus], Auctor Naturæ supplet eas

page.notes: Show-through from the facing page appears at the right edge and in the right margin; these fragments are not transcribed. The first line "cùs, quod ipsis eorum formis" and the word "virtutibus" (printed as "{virtuti-" with hyphen at line end) are read with some uncertainty; the bracketed "[virtutibus]" reflects the hyphenated line break "virtuti-" / "bus".
